content_sections.heading: About CIT Chandigarh
content_sections.text: The Chandigarh Institute for Transformation works under the aegis of the Planning & Evaluation Organization, Chandigarh Administration, at the Chandigarh Secretariat, Sector 9, Chandigarh. The posts serve the SIT, which works with NITI Aayog and the Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI). The work covers development strategies, sectoral targets, KPIs, and monitoring and evaluation for UT Chandigarh.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: All three posts are filled on contract through the open market.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Minimum 10 (Ten) years' experience relevant to the job description. Preference will be given to persons with on-field experience with State/UT government, and work experience in project management, project appraisal, monitoring & evaluation, and policy advocacy in the areas of governance, development-related projects and programme implementation. Candidates should also have experience in leading teams and managing projects. Experience from an internship or training will not be considered. Minimum 8 (eight) years' experience relevant to the job description. Preference will be given to persons with work experience in the Urban Infrastructure, Planning, Transport & Mobility Sector. Candidates should also have experience in working in a team and managing projects. Experience from an internship or training will not be considered. Minimum 8 (eight) years' experience relevant to the job description. Preference will be given to persons with work experience in the Environment, Climate Action & Eco-Tourism Sector. Candidates should also have experience in working in a team and managing projects. Experience from an internship or training will not be considered. Experience in stakeholder management Experience in drafting reports and reviewing detailed project reports Prior experience with Government and other international organizations is desirable Knowledge and experience related to National/State planning Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent IT skills Experience in stakeholder management Experience in carrying out research and preparing policy briefs Experience in drafting reports and reviewing detailed project reports Prior experience with Government and other international organizations is desirable Knowledge and experience related to National/State planning Excellent analytical & problem-solving skills Excellent IT skills Candidates need excellent verbal and written English and Hindi skills and a demonstrated ability to communicate well in a multi-cultural environment. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration per month is Rs 1,50,000/- for the Team Leader and Rs 1,00,000/- for each Sector Expert. It is "Consolidated inclusive of all". Appointment is contractual and made through the open market. Period of contract: financial approval till Financial Year 2030-31. Location of posting: Chandigarh. Leave: staff are entitled to the holidays listed by the Chandigarh Administration, plus 18 days of leave in the whole year.

content_sections.heading: CIT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: To develop & monitor KPIs for UT Chandigarh and prepare report on monthly basis. To collaborate with renowned institutions/organizations such as ISB, PEC, Panjab University etc. for keeping development roadmap aligned to latest sectoral advancements. Provide independent insight on strategy proposed by consultancy firms/UN agencies/International Organizations on monthly basis. To design and conduct 2 field surveys and studies on different sectors of the economy in collaboration with organizations of National and International repute. Maintain synergy between the Planning & Evaluation Organization, Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI) and NITI Aayog. To assist SIT in achieving its objectives in collaboration with NITI Aayog and the Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI). Preparation of development strategies, sectoral targets and socio-economic goals as per the UT's requirements and roadmap to achieve the same. Draft policy briefs, presentations and other documents. Coordination with development partners and technical agency concerned. Support mechanisms for strengthening horizontal and vertical coordination within Chandigarh Administration. Assist UT in strengthening the monitoring & evaluation ecosystem. Create and facilitate cross learning platforms. Documentation of activities performed under SIT. Preparation of the UT, regional and sectoral reports on regular basis. Regular update on progress in UT using the portal maintained by NITI Aayog. Plan and organize workshops and other events related to the SIT, including preparation of inputs for the workshop. Perform such other functions as may be necessary for the interest of the Mission. To develop and monitor KPIs related to Urban Infrastructure, Planning, Transport & Mobility Sector for UT Chandigarh and prepare report on monthly basis. To collaborate with renowned institutions/organizations such as ISB, PEC, Panjab University etc. for keeping development roadmap aligned to latest advancements in Urban Infrastructure, Planning, Transport & Mobility Sector. Provide independent insight on strategy proposed by consultancy firms/UN agencies/International Organizations on Urban Infrastructure, Planning, Transport & Mobility Sector on monthly basis. To design and conduct 2 field surveys and studies on Urban Infrastructure, Planning, Transport & Mobility Sector in collaboration with organizations of National and International repute. Maintain synergy between the State Planning Department, Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI) and NITI Aayog. To assist SIT in achieving its objectives in collaboration with NITI Aayog and Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI). Evaluation and assessment of existing strategies, methodologies, and systems to improve the socio-economic condition of UT Chandigarh. Preparation of development strategies, sectoral targets and socio-economic goals as per the UT's requirements and roadmap to achieve the same. Draft policy briefs, presentations and other documents. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CIT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies, 1 each for Team Leader, Sector Expert I (Urban Infrastructure, Planning, Transport & Mobility) and Sector Expert II (Environment, Climate Action & Eco-Tourism).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CIT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 10 November 2026. By that date, the application form and self-attested testimonials must be handed in at the Planning & Evaluation Organization or emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Team Leader post?
faq.answer: The Team Leader needs a Masters in Economics or MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) or equivalent with considerable amount of field experience post highest qualification. The post also needs a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience do the Sector Expert posts need?
faq.answer: Sector Expert I and Sector Expert II each need a minimum of 8 years' experience relevant to the job description, including experience of working in a team and managing projects. Experience from an internship or training is not counted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CIT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For all three posts, candidates must be below 50 years of age as on the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary in CIT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Team Leader gets Rs. 1,50,000 a month and each Sector Expert gets Rs. 1,00,000 a month. The pay is consolidated and inclusive of all.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CIT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form from the Chandigarh Administration public notices page and attach self-attested copies of your testimonials. Hand it in at Planning & Evaluation Organization, III Floor, Chandigarh Secretariat, Sector 9, Chandigarh, or email it to [email protected] by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CIT Chandigarh job permanent?
faq.answer: No. All three posts are contractual and filled through the open market, with financial approval till Financial Year 2030-31.

faq.question: Q9. How much leave do CIT Chandigarh staff get?
faq.answer: Staff are entitled to the holidays listed by the Chandigarh Administration, plus 18 days of leave in the whole year.

faq.question: Q10. Which languages must candidates know?
faq.answer: Candidates need excellent verbal and written English and Hindi skills and the ability to communicate well in a multi-cultural environment.
